title: Docker artifacts example test: retry only `docker compose pull`, and run log and cleanup from an EXIT trap
answers: Why did the artifacts Docker integration test fail in CI when Docker Hub timed out pulling postgres?
How do I make the MLflow artifacts Docker example test tolerate transient registry failures?
Where is the docker compose logs and down cleanup handled for the artifacts example test?
If the Docker example test fails midway, does cleanup still run and is the exit code preserved?
body:
Path: tests/tracking/test_mlflow_artifacts.py:test_mlflow_artifacts_example writes a bash script that runs the artifacts example end to end: `docker compose pull --ignore-buildable`, then ./build.sh, then `docker compose run ... client python example.py`, and is used by the Docker-based tracking integration test.
Rule: Retry only the image pull (3 attempts, sleeps of 5s and 10s) before building or running. Put `set -e` on the script so build and application failures stop it immediately and are never retried. Put `docker compose logs` and `docker compose down {rmi_option} --volumes --remove-orphans` in an `EXIT` trap that saves `$?`, runs each step with `|| status=1`, and exits with that status. Cleanup then runs exactly once on every path, including after an exhausted pull, and failures from logs or cleanup still produce a nonzero exit.
Symptom: The CI job for the artifacts example failed when Docker Hub's auth endpoint timed out while pulling `postgres`. The example was never run, so the failure looked like an application bug rather than a registry blip.
Constraints: Applies to the shell script generated by test_mlflow_artifacts_example only. Do not wrap build.sh or the `docker compose run` application step in the retry loop. Do not add cleanup calls after an explicit `exit 1`, since the trap already covers that. Pre-existing per-test cleanup elsewhere is not affected.
applies: Docker-based artifacts example integration test in tests/tracking; does not cover other Docker test scripts.
says: The artifact integration test failed in continuous integration because the container registry timed out.
Why did the containerized artifact sample test fail before running any application code?
Ensure container cleanup and diagnostic logs always run when the artifact test suite crashes.
Make the automated artifact tracking example tolerate temporary image registry download failures during testing.
Failed container builds in the artifact example test should stop immediately without being retried.
search: `tests/tracking/test_mlflow_artifacts.py:test_mlflow_artifacts_example` retries only `docker compose pull --ignore-buildable` across 3 attempts before running `examples/mlflow_artifacts/build.sh` and the containerized example. The generated script sets `set -e` so build and application failures terminate immediately without retries. An `EXIT` trap executes `docker compose logs` and `docker compose down {rmi_option} --volumes --remove-orphans`, preserving failing exit statuses across all exit paths. Guidance applies exclusively to the shell script in `test_mlflow_artifacts_example` and does not affect other Docker test scripts or wrap application runs in retries.
